question: With the frozen nine-slot account, 75% original 2R scale-out, low-prior-ATR entry priority, and fixed protected stop, does confirming an adverse EMA20/EMA50 reversal on 1, 2, or 3 consecutive completed 12H closes improve on the existing intrabar EMA-cross exit?
single_variable: EMA exit confirmation cadence only: existing intrabar strict EMA cross baseline versus 1, 2, or 3 consecutive actually confirmed adverse 12H EMA20/EMA50 closes, exiting at the next available 1H open. All event rows, controls, stop, 2R limit, scale-out, fees, priority, slots, and account rules are frozen.

frozen_source.join_key: paths.source_row_number equals the 1-based data-row ordinal in frozen signals.csv; cross-check symbol, week, side, key_open_bjt, confirmed_bjt

frozen_parent.control_priority: the frozen parent's prior_atr_pct inherited through source_row_number

cadence.baseline: Existing V1.7 intrabar strict EMA cross, reused from the frozen parent paths.
cadence.adverse_definition: At each actually present, EMA-ready UTC12H close, adverse means side * (EMA20 - EMA50) < 0; exact zero is non-adverse and resets the streak.
cadence.consecutive_definition: Only adjacent actual 12H bar opens exactly 12 hours apart count; a missing 12H bar, unready EMA, or zero/opposite EMA spread resets the run.
cadence.causality: Count only completed 12H closes strictly later than the frozen entry_ms. Once N consecutive adverse closes are complete, exit at the first observed 1H open whose timestamp is at or after that close time. An exit may not occur at the entry timestamp.
cadence.intrabar_cross: Disabled only for candidate modes; original confirmed EMA spread is gated until the consecutive-close threshold is met.
cadence.gap_and_stale_precedence: Keep the original VectorBT callback precedence: a first next-observed 1H open after a data gap or the existing stale-12H deadline is marked before the bar's OHLC or cadence exit; never backfill the previous close.
cadence.entry_alignment: Every executable frozen signal and matched control must have strict side-aligned confirmed EMA20/EMA50 spread at entry; fail closed if this invariant is violated.

fixed_execution.entry: Frozen parent exact 1H open at the completed UTC12H confirmation timestamp, taker market fill.
fixed_execution.stop: Keep each frozen signal's original touched-1.618 outside default stop fixed; matched controls keep the inherited parent risk fraction. Same stop for both scale-out legs throughout.
fixed_execution.take_profit: Original resting 2R limit at actual entry plus side * 2 * actual entry-to-stop risk; close 75% at maker fee and keep 25% runner.
fixed_execution.controls: Reuse the parent's same-symbol, same-NY-week, same-side, EMA-aligned, prior-ATR-matched random non-signal confirmations, strictly after the parent confirmation; preserve unmatched rows and the paired parent identity.
fixed_execution.capacity: Reuse the existing nine-slot scale-out capacity runner; one position per symbol, frozen low-prior-ATR same-time ordering, no leverage or rebalancing.

selection.eligible_if: At least 100 closed development positions, fee-net wins >=30%, equal-notional fee-net payoff >=2.5, conservative hourly drawdown bound <=35%.
selection.pick: Highest development funded account growth among eligible baseline/cadence modes; if none qualify, retain intrabar_baseline. Show the highest-growth mode descriptively even when it fails a gate.
selection.later_periods: Report 2025 and 2026 YTD after the development pick; do not use them to select cadence.
selection.historical_exploration: Sequential historical research; development and later years have been seen in prior cloud-close screens.

execution.path_callback: Reuse yoyo.evaluation.cloud_close_reward_paths._order_func via _simulate_symbol; do not implement another fill simulator.
execution.account_runner: Reuse yoyo.evaluation.cloud_close_slots.run, which delegates 75%/25% legs to cloud_close_scaleout and cloud_close_reward_account.

required_checks: Synthetic 1/2/3 close counter opens only after the Nth actual confirmation; a missing 12H open resets the run.
Synthetic same-bar stop/2R dual touch resolves to the original protective stop and records ambiguity.
Synthetic entry-open stop remains an immediate next-open stop with both fills at the observed entry open.
Synthetic unexpected H1 gap closes at the next observed open with gap flag and outranks the cadence trigger.
Strict EMA alignment is checked on every executable frozen event and control at its entry open.
Every safe bound returned by _safe_path_end is chronological; series_tail_close is allowed only at the true hourly file tail.
No parent rows, signal/control pairings, TP legs, or source identities are dropped; unmatched and no-entry rows remain explicit.
Development pick and selected/best-mode checks include matched controls, paired signals, and 5bp adverse market-fill stress.
